info.title: DEWA Simulator
info.description: Local synthetic API. Signed interactive user identity or broker-issued user token with current exact-operation grant required. JWT subject owns the account; caller user headers do not grant authority. A separate read-only settlement machine lane retrieves captured charge proofs. Legacy fixture mode is outside this reference security profile.

get.description: List personal and household accounts belonging to the trusted actor.
Read an owned source reversal result after a lost response. No money return is inferred from a request alone.

post.description: Fetch and verify the current gateway refund, reverse only the exact applied original payment, and persist an APPLIED or REJECTED decision atomically.
Release only a recharge target fence after this exact applied credit is SETTLED at the gateway. Other obligation locks remain intact.
Freeze current source terms for one owned stored order.

get.description: Inspect the current provider reservation and receipt.

post.description: Verify the current gateway CAPTURING order before admitting its exact capture.
Release only after the gateway permanently fences capture as cancelled/failed.
Apply the exact admitted captured order through gateway settlement claims.

get.description: Inspect an owned persisted settlement fence and safely retry its gateway acknowledgement/release. Historical used-payment records can reconcile as applied.
Read provider-owned revisioned obligations, including settled/withdrawn history and effective discounts.
Read the current owned obligation and revision-bound reference without cached POST retry results.

post.description: Require the current payable revision. This preflight does not authorize or capture funds.
Settle the current revision with an owned revision-bound captured payment. Durable order/claim orchestration remains a separate gate.

get.description: Read an account-owned smart meter and consumption snapshot.

post.description: Settle a bill after checking its captured payment reference and amount.
Activate a simulated utility connection for the current account.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Keycloak access token

Error.description: Validation, ownership, delegation, payment, conflict or availability error

x-idempotency-policy: Persisted per account for the lifetime of the demo database. Reusing a key with a different method, path or body returns 409.
